mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1300.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and broadening economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 103.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based demand surge that strengthens corporate earnings outlooks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger central bank hawkishness and equity market risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 4.3%, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payroll growth signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) combined with stable or rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of expanding GDPC1 and rising HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
